title: SINAMICS S120 Drive Functions
locator: Motor data identification, speed controller optimization and moment of inertia pre-control
notes: SINAMICS S120-specific manual describes rotating motor identification, load-to-motor inertia ratio determination, speed-controller optimization and acceleration feedforward scaling. Procedures and parameters apply only to the stated Siemens drive family/firmware context and are not generic CNC tuning values. PDF is linked only.
